title: Wipro Product Testing and Compliance Services for Market Readiness
summary: Product testing and compliance services from Wipro Tarang Labs cover EMI EMC, safety, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and TEC conformance testing for manufacturers
body_markdown:
Ensure your products meet global standards with precise testing and proven compliance, backed by our product testing and compliance services.


Tarang Labs, a part of Wipro, is an ISO/IEC 17025 accredited independent product testing laboratory for product qualification and compliance services. With state-of-the-art infrastructure and a dedicated team, we operate 24x7 to empower our customers in bringing superior quality products to the market through reliable product testing services.


At Tarang Labs, we offer a comprehensive suite of services designed to ensure your products meet the highest standards of quality and compliance.


**A Quality Assurance Ecosystem of Infinite Possibilities**


We partner with businesses to make their products and services safe, sustainable and compliant with ever evolving regulations through quality assurance testing and product compliance services. Tarang Labs also offers consultancy services for standards compliance, certification testing, pre-certification testing and interoperability.


If you are a B2B business, then our globally recognized certifications get you faster approvals from your customers’ purchase function. If you are a B2C business, our certifications get you quicker access to multiple markets, greater trust from customers, and lower warranty costs, enabled by robust product qualification testing.
